title: Without See Financial Data Mark as No Charge and the checkbox are hidden
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with line 1 of 2.0 hours and line 2 of 1.5 hours with one stock part costing $40.00, both at the customer's labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Work Orders — Create & Edit' but not 'See Financial Data', at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open line 2's three-dots menu.
  3. Click "Edit line".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu offers no "Mark as No Charge".

Step 3:

  • Edit Line shows no "No Charge" checkbox.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-N4: “If the user lacks 'See Financial Data', the items are not offered and the checkbox is hidden.”
  • S12-R12: “Mark as No Charge, Change category and Mark as Billable need 'Work Orders — Create & Edit' and 'See Financial Data'; without 'See Financial Data' the chip is shown and the prices are hidden as today. The work order list, Board and bulk actions do not change: a billable work order with no-charge lines is listed as billable.”
